content:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT detected: spike in 5xxs for /v1/generate in eu-west-1. ~1.2k errors/min across multiple tenants. Paging #incidents and @oncall. Link: <https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/2075012345>

maya: i'm on it. seeing huge error tail and latency. looks like requests are being routed to a cold model variant in eu-west-1 and then triggering region fallback loops.

liam: oncall here. can you confirm which variant is being chosen?

maya: logs show `variant=rw-14b-q4` for traffic that historically used `rw-7b`. kv-cache misses are massive.

sarah: paging cs to prep comms. @cust-success-bot please create a short notice for affected customers.

maya: quick root note: we rolled a config schema migration last night that deprecated `fallback_mode` in favor of `fallback_strategy`. the migration left `fallback_mode` populated for some orgs. runtime precedence treats legacy field as higher priority when present -> ends up choosing "variant-first" behavior for those orgs. that + cold kv-cache leads to retries -> regional failover loops.

emily: example policy blob from logs for org-4242: 
```
{
  "route": {
    "preferred_region": "eu-west-1",
    "fallback_mode": "variant-first",
    "allowed_variants": ["rw-14b-q4","rw-7b"]
  }
}
```
this should have been converted to `fallback_strategy` but migration left the legacy key.

darren: putting SRE on infra watch. @eng-sre can someone look at autoscaler and region failover config?

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: Routing fallback loops. Steps: 1) Apply transient global override to stop legacy precedence. 2) Quarantine affected orgs (move to safe routing policy). 3) Throttle new sessions to eu-west-1 to drain KV pressure. 4) Rollback migration if conversion errors persist. <https://runbooks.redwood/routing-fallbacks>

maya: mitigation plan summary: 
1) set global override `global.routing.fallback_strategy = "variant-prefer"` at runtime to neutralize legacy `fallback_mode` behavior.
2) apply temporary rate-limit on eu-west-1 generation traffic to 60% of normal.
3) start targeted rollback of migration for org-4242 and other impacted tenants.

liam: running override now: `adminctl config set global.routing.fallback_strategy variant-prefer --env runtime`
liam: override applied. monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/ops/routing-eu-west-1

maya: immediate effect: 5xx rate down ~78% in 4 minutes. some residual errors tied to cold starts.

cust-success-bot: Draft sent to CS: "We're aware of intermittent generation errors in EU. We've applied mitigations and will follow up with a detailed incident report. If you are experiencing production impact please reply with org id."

sarah: starting rollback of conversion for org-4242 now. ETA ~12m. will track progress in that org's migration task.

emily: preliminary root cause: conversion script for schema flip failed to clear legacy keys when encountering a specific allowed_variants pattern. Missing test coverage for cross-field precedence and no canary for config schema change.

darren: tl;dr: schema flip left stale keys -> runtime picks legacy semantics -> wrong variant routing -> KV miss -> regional fallback loops -> 5xx storm.

liam: rollback for org-4242 complete. perf has recovered to baseline for that org.

maya: monitoring shows overall error rate steadying near baseline. still keeping throttles for 10 more minutes.

emily: immediate code fixes: 1) migration script fix to atomically remove `fallback_mode` and set `fallback_strategy`. 2) add unit + integration tests for precedence. 3) add guard in runtime: if both keys present log and prefer the newer key (and emit metric).

darren: ops items: 1) expand canary window for future schema flips to 48h and add a low-traffic canary path. 2) add alert for sudden spikes in cross-variant kv-cache-miss ratio. 3) add automatic rollback trigger if conversion error rate > 0.5%.

maya: handing off to night oncall @liam in 15. notes: override active, rollback progressing, throttles scheduled to remove at +30m if stable, ticket #INC-2026-4823 created with summary and links.

liam: taking over. if error rate > 300/min escalate to exec-sre and notify product leadership. i'll keep the page open.

oncall-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: error rate returned to baseline in eu-west-1. Incident transitioned to mitigated. Ticket: #INC-2026-4823.

maya: thanks all. postmortem owners: emily (migration + runtime fix), maya (ops run), liam (oncall followup), sarah (customer comms). postmortem scheduled tomorrow 11:00 UTC.

reactions: :white_check_mark: by liam, :eyes: by emily, :pray: by maya
